name: VT VACUUM TECHNOLOGIES PVT LTD
india_angle: VT Vacuum Technologies is India's largest supplier of ultra-high vacuum equipment and components, serving research organizations, universities, and industries including semiconductor.
summary: VT Vacuum Technologies supplies ultra-high vacuum and cryogenic equipment, as well as deposition systems, primarily to the semiconductor and electronics industries. They are a key player in the Indian market, providing imported high-tech equipment to support advanced manufacturing and research applications.
